# Test fixtures (hand-made, NOT real data)

Every file in this directory was written by hand for the test suite.

* Advisory IDs use the made-up prefix `FIXTURE-` and the CVE aliases use the
  year 2099 (`CVE-2099-...`). They are **not real vulnerabilities**.
* Package names start with `fixture` so they cannot be confused with real
  packages.
* `kev.json` imitates the *shape* of the CISA KEV JSON feed; its entries are
  invented.
* No record here was copied from OSV, GitHub, PyPA, Debian, Ubuntu or CISA.
